claims.statement: The Commission estimates roughly 75% of EU buildings perform poorly and annual renovation is about 1%.
IPMVP determines savings through consistent before-and-after measurement with adjustments for changing conditions.

contrary_evidence: Certificates, utilities, auditors, and IPMVP practitioners already provide parts of this service.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: ESCOs, banks, subsidy advisers, and family installers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 5000 projects at 1800 PLN yield 9 million PLN revenue and founder equity above 5 million PLN in six to eight years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-20 hours weekly with energy-auditor approval.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 65% after data review and partner share.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1000-4000 PLN per project plus a lawful 1-3% enablement fee.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: contractors submit each project and lenders repeatedly query benchmarks.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Each project improves yield curves and future risk selection
fingerprint.customer: Building owners, ESCOs, banks, and guarantee providers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded intake through lenders and subsidy advisers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Meter-based verification plus portfolio benchmark API
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A contractor, lender, or owner pays when verification is issued
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A retrofit needs credible ex-post savings evidence

founder_fit: Statistical modeling and family installer access align while finance and audit functions stay with partners.

structure.control_point: A normalized dataset linking retrofit packages to verified savings, variance, contractor, and persistence
structure.critical_dependency: Consented interval data, credible baselines, and a financing partner

thesis: An independent retrofit measurement registry turns consented meter data into intervention yield curves and underwriting analytics for lenders and guarantee partners.
title: Retrofit Yield Registry
uncertainties: Meter access, small-project budgets, and lender reliance are unknown.
